A shallow annular collar is added on the underside around that central opening, so it should be treated as a hollow ring rather than a filled disk or rectangular pad. The added end sections are much taller than the base, while the underside collar is only a shallow lower tier, creating a clear stepped-depth relationship.

runs.condition: The model has a flat rectangular base with raised long side walls, leaving an open channel rather than a filled block. A short rectangular added wall or tab sits at one end inside the side-wall outline and is lower than the tallest raised portions. Inside the channel is a centered row of annular cylindrical posts; these are added ring-shaped solids with real central openings, not floor cutouts. The posts and the taller rectangular build rise from the upper face of the base, while another rectangular addition stops at a lower level, so the top heights are stepped.

Build the main reference as a rectangular base with length 0.75, width 0.375, and height 0.0375, using a main extrusion depth of 0.0375. Add the raised rectangular upper material with outer footprint 0.75 by 0.375, flush to the left, right, front, and back edges of the base; it starts from the upper side of the base and reaches 0.1312 from the base datum, with extrusion depth 0.0937. Keep the visible channel interior open between the raised wall material rather than filling it with a separate rectangular pad above the base. Add one narrower rectangular solid at the left end with footprint 0.0319 by 0.3094, left edge offset 0, right edge offset 0.7181, front offset 0.0281, and back offset 0.0375; it starts on the upper side of the base at 0.0375 and reaches 0.0937 from the base datum, with height 0.05625 and extrusion depth 0.0562. Place four separate annular cylindrical posts on the upper face of the base, all centered across the width at front offset 0.1875, with axes at left offsets 0.15, 0.3, 0.45, and 0.6. The post outer radii are 0.0469, 0.0469, 0.0562, and 0.0562 respectively, and the matching through central opening radii are 0.0188, 0.0197, 0.0216, and 0.0234. Each annular post spans from 0.0375 to 0.1312 relative to the base reference plane, using extrusion depth 0.0937, and the posts remain separate cylinders with no rectangular filled plate connecting their footprint envelope.
